Definition

A personal essay is a short written work that lets a writer describe a personal
   experience or significant event based on their experiences or worldview. It's often
   written in the first person.


Everyone has a story to tell and a message to share. Personal essays relate the
   author’s intimate thoughts and experiences to universal truths. They aren’t
  simply a retelling of events, though. They conclude with the author having
   learned, changed, or grown in some way and often present some truth or insight
   that challenges the reader to draw their own conclusions.





                                                                                                                                       2

Personal essay vs. narrative essay




While a personal essay focuses on reflection and personal growth, a narrative
   essay emphasizes the elements of a story to bring the overall experience to life.


Sometimes, however, people interchangeably use terms such as personal
   essay/statement, expressive essay, narrative essay, and descriptive essay.





                                                                                                                                        3

Personal essay vs. formal essay



A formal essay is more objective than the narrative or personal essay because it is
   usually based on provable facts and examples.





                                                                                                                                       4

Common topics

My bravest moment
How I met my best friend
What makes my mom or dad special
How I overcame a fear
Why I will succeed
A special place for me
An odd experience that didn't make sense at the time
What superpower I would choose
If I could switch lives with someone
…



                                                                                                                                       5

Common mistakes in writing a personal essay
Absence of organization.
     Make a list of the things you want to discuss in your paper, which will greatly save your time and nerves in the
        future.
Boring topic.
     Make sure your story is meaningful and engaging, modern and interesting for the audience. Try to select a
        relevant topic, spicing it up with examples from your own life.
No structure.
     Make sure you know what elements your essay should include in order to make it logical and easy to read.
Absence of moral.
    A personal essay should teach the audience a particular lesson. That is why you not only need to tell the story
       but also explain how it changed your personality/life and how it can contribute to the reader.
Inappropriate lexis.
     Avoid slang and clichés, which may make the text much weaker.





                                                                                                                                       6

Typical structure

 The standard length of a personal essay is about five paragraphs, but it can be longer or shorter, as long as it contains all
 three basic sections:


   Introduction: The first sentences of your essay should include a hook that captures the reader’s attention. Close this
    paragraph with a catchy thesis statement.


   Body: The body of your essay is the meat of your story that should include your main points and personal evidence
     supporting the thesis statement of your personal essay. This is where you, as a writer, share how your personal
     experiences shaped your point of view, and reflect on the knowledge gleaned.


   Conclusion: Your conclusion should restate your thesis and contain the moral of your story or a revelation of a
    deeper truth. Review why this essay matters and sum up the things you want the reader to take away from this
     particular piece. Try not to add new information in this section, as it is only for summarizing the essay not for
     introduction new details.





                                                                                                                                         7

How to write a good personal essay

 1. Create an essay outline.
   Drafting a personal essay outline first can help you lay out the main points and tone of the message you
   are trying to share. Your outline will help you figure out early on if this specific moment is worth
   writing about. Whichever topic you choose for your essay, it must have had a strong emotional impact
  on you or have taught you a lesson in some way.


 2. Start with your introduction.
  Form an emotional connection with the reader. Set your audience up for what your piece will be about
  and give them something to look forward to.


 3. Fill your body paragraphs.
  Use sensory details about the sequence of events surrounding your thesis to guide the reader through
  your personal essay. Build up your personal story here to eventually lead the reader to your main point.





                                                                                                                                         8

How to write a good personal essay

 4. Be specific.
  A descriptive essay about a significant moment in your life is much more engaging than a general overview of
   something that happened to you. Provide the details necessary about real life characters or any particular feelings
   experienced.

 5. Include a conclusion.
  Summarize what you learned from your experience and what message you hope to pass on to the reader. It might be
   a difficult or unsettling revelation, but ending on a generally positive or hopeful note can help it feel more
   aspirational or uplifting.


 6. Proofread your work.
   Aside from checking spelling and grammar, make sure your intent is clear and your writing is easy to follow. No
   matter how good your writing skills are, it’s always helpful to reread your own work and ensure you’ve solidified
   your story.





                                                                                                                                         9
